== a plain image
name="Nome" type=image/png 40x30 size=107 generated=false kind="" parent=- uploadedBy=true rows=1 files=[campaigns/<uuid>/images/<uuid>,campaigns/<uuid>/images/<uuid>.thumb]

== an image with a reference
name="Nome" type=image/png 40x30 size=107 generated=false kind="" parent=- uploadedBy=true rows=1 files=[campaigns/<uuid>/images/<uuid>,campaigns/<uuid>/images/<uuid>.ref,campaigns/<uuid>/images/<uuid>.thumb]

(parent stored first)
== a generated image whose parent is there
name="Nome" type=image/png 40x30 size=107 generated=true kind="scene" parent=set uploadedBy=true rows=2 files=[campaigns/<uuid>/images/<uuid>,campaigns/<uuid>/images/<uuid>.thumb,campaigns/<uuid>/images/<uuid>,campaigns/<uuid>/images/<uuid>.thumb]

== a generated image whose parent is gone
name="Nome" type=image/png 40x30 size=107 generated=true kind="map_scene" parent=- uploadedBy=true rows=1 files=[campaigns/<uuid>/images/<uuid>,campaigns/<uuid>/images/<uuid>.thumb]

(finish got the row's id: true, read the row inside the transaction: true)
== a finish that succeeds
name="Nome" type=image/png 40x30 size=107 generated=false kind="" parent=- uploadedBy=true rows=1 files=[campaigns/<uuid>/images/<uuid>,campaigns/<uuid>/images/<uuid>.thumb]

== a finish that fails
error=internal: internal error code=internal internal error rows=0 files=[]

== a finish that finds the request closed
error=maps: the image request is closed code=- rows=0 files=[]

== a finish that refuses with an HTTP error
error=too many pixels code=http 400 DIMENSIONS "too many pixels" rows=0 files=[]

== a finish that refuses with a Connect error
error=failed_precondition: not now code=failed_precondition not now rows=0 files=[]

== the 1th file cannot be written
error=cannot store the image right now, please try again code=http 503  "cannot store the image right now, please try again" rows=0 files=[]

== the 2th file cannot be written
error=cannot store the image right now, please try again code=http 503  "cannot store the image right now, please try again" rows=0 files=[]

== the 3th file cannot be written
error=cannot store the image right now, please try again code=http 503  "cannot store the image right now, please try again" rows=0 files=[]

== a gallery at its image limit
error=the campaign's gallery is full code=http 429 QUOTA "the campaign's gallery is full" rows=1 files=[campaigns/<uuid>/images/<uuid>,campaigns/<uuid>/images/<uuid>.thumb]

== an image that exactly fills the bytes
name="Nome" type=image/png 40x30 size=107 generated=false kind="" parent=- uploadedBy=true rows=1 files=[campaigns/<uuid>/images/<uuid>,campaigns/<uuid>/images/<uuid>.thumb]

== an image one byte over the bytes
error=the campaign's gallery is full code=http 429 QUOTA "the campaign's gallery is full" rows=0 files=[]
